name: receiveOrderedProduct
intent: Record receipt of the selected product order and update the stock referenced by its entries.
pre: A product order with the supplied orderID exists.
post: Set the selected order's status to RECEIVED.
For each entry in the selected order, its item's resulting stock must equal that item's stock before this operation plus that entry's quantity.
difficulty_basis: Per-entry stock effects are explicit, but repeated references to the same item are unresolved.
missing: Original order-entry invariant or receipt specification must resolve multiple entries referencing the same Item. Reference imposes per-entry equations against one pre-state; with different quantities for the same item these cannot all hold. Jest uses three distinct items. No aggregate-per-item policy or uniqueness guard invented.
scenarios: Three distinct items have stocks 1/2/3 changed to 2/4/6; RECEIVED and true agree. Aliasing is untested.
effects_audit: No REQUESTED-status guard, cumulative sequential update or entry deletion inferred; literal simultaneous per-entry relation retained pending aliasing clarification.
